title: Scenario simulation
description: Set perturbations and candidate actions, then compare baseline, scenario and scenario + actions

perturb.title: Perturbations
perturb.noNumeric: This object type has no numeric properties
perturb.empty: Add at least one perturbation to run the simulation
perturb.delayPickProperty: Pick a time property (e.g. lead time) to convert it into a relative change
perturb.delayNoCurrent: The current value is missing or not positive; the delay cannot be converted
perturb.delayCapped: More than 100% of the current value; simulated as +100%

candidates.title: Candidate actions (from the ontology)
candidates.empty: Choose perturbed objects to see available actions
candidates.paramsHint: Empty parameters are filled by the simulator from ontology defaults

runHint: At least one complete perturbation (object + property) is required

impact.title: Impact scope
impact.empty: Run the simulation to see the impact scope

compare.title: Three-way comparison
compare.note: Values are computed by the deterministic simulator, not by an LLM
compare.empty: Run the simulation to see the comparison

ai.rulesHint: Today's AI quota is used up; you can still generate, the result will be rule ranked

save.title: Save scenario
save.hint: Saving runs the simulation with the current perturbations and candidate actions and stores it under this name
